question: What conduct should a practitioner adopt after gaining mental equipoise through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind.
Village duties bind one to ordinary life.
The teaching prescribes abandonment of such duties.
inference: Through practice one becomes even-minded and should abandon village duties.
uncertainties: grāma-dharmañ may refer broadly to conventional social obligations
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the duties of village life.
